title: Integrate the remaining roadmaps and refresh FS3 planning readiness
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 6, 2026 approval to proceed with the proposed priorities after PR #50. Verify the production Pages deployment; reconstruct the unique work from conflicting PR #49 on the current main branch; publish the four remaining roadmap families and a report-ready FS3 planning-evidence package; preserve unsupported operational, procurement, performance, and timing values as Coverage Gaps; and prepare an all-19-roadmap V05 package for independent review. Continue HPCI operations, five-year cost, EEA1 reproducibility, application-requirement, and Safe Fetch readiness work without self-attesting external security controls. All outputs must use public information only and remain provisional, single-model, and Consensus-incomplete. This directive does not authorize merging a Pull Request, unattended production research, procurement, technology adoption, or representation of an incomplete review package as Consensus.
